name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard terms for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA), governing the mutual exchange and protection of confidential information between two parties.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the parties, purpose, effective date, and key business terms that incorporate the standard terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for early access programs where a partner tests a product and provides feedback.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement defining uptime and response time targets and service credits, designed to be used with the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement for services engagements governed by statements of work (SOWs).

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement governing the processing of personal data between controllers, processors, and subprocessors.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing installable or on-premises software.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement covering cooperation, payment and taxes, trademark licensing, and related terms between partners.

name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement addressing HIPAA obligations for the use and disclosure of protected health information.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for short-term product trials or evaluations before committing to a longer-term commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum supplementing an underlying agreement with terms for AI services, model training, and ownership of inputs and outputs.
